beyond: "from Bing experiments": the abstract mentions Bing only as where experiments affect revenue by millions; it does not say all five outcomes come from Bing experiments.

"puzzling outcomes in thousands of online controlled experiments": the abstract says thousands of experiments have been run and that the root causes generalized to multiple experiments; it does not say the puzzling outcomes were analysed across thousands of experiments (the title says five outcomes).

"from Microsoft and others": the abstract lists other companies only as users of controlled experiments; it does not say any of the puzzling outcomes come from outside the authors' own experience at Microsoft.
"Bing and other": the abstract does not say which systems the five outcomes come from; Bing is mentioned only in the context of revenue impact.
